transcript.content: Hello, thank you for coming in. Can you tell me what’s been bothering you or what brings you here today?

I guess I'm here because... my brain just feels like it stalls out. I'll sit at my desk with a test report, or even just a simple CAD note open for an hour, and... I just can't decide what the next sentence or checkbox should be. It's just blank.
Have you noticed that you’re not enjoying things that you used to find pleasurable, like hobbies, work tasks, or time with friends?

Yeah, I guess so. I used to print miniatures, but... my printer has just been sitting there with the same half-finished figure on it for months. I just don't care to finish it. And things like yoga, or even just walking in the woods... they just feel like another chore now. It's just another thing I have to do, not something I actually want to do.
Have you ever felt this way before, where things felt like chores and you lost interest in activities, or is this the first time you’ve experienced this?
No... I don't think so. I guess this is the first time it's been like this.
How long have you been feeling this way? Has it been going on for at least a couple of weeks, or longer?
It's been... a while. Longer than a few weeks. I guess it started when they moved me to the prototype-testing role. That was... about a year and a month ago.
Have you been feeling tired or lacking energy most days, even when you haven't been doing anything physically or mentally demanding?
No... I don't really think so. I'm not physically tired. Just... like I said, I just don't care to do much.
Have you been feeling like you’re not good enough at work or in other areas of your life, or been overly critical of yourself lately?

I guess so. I just... I keep replaying these tiny mistakes from the lab. Over and over. It makes me feel like... I'm not just bad at the job, but... I don't know, just a bad person. Like I deserve whatever consequences come from it.
Have you noticed any difficulty thinking clearly, concentrating, or making decisions lately?

Yeah... that's actually why I came in. My brain just... it feels like it stalls out. I'll sit there at work with a test report open, or just a simple CAD note, and... I can't do it. An hour will go by and I just can't decide what the next sentence should be, or which box to check. It just stops working.
Have you noticed that you’ve lost interest in most things, even things you used to care about, not just activities but life in general?

Yeah, I guess so. I just... I don't really do much anymore. My 3D printer for miniatures has just been sitting there with the same half-finished figure on it for months. I used to like doing yoga, or just going for a walk in the woods, but... now it just feels like another chore. It's not something I actually want to do. I just don't have the interest.
Has there been a time recently when you felt completely unable to do your work or carry out everyday tasks because of how you were feeling mentally?

Um... yeah, I guess so. I actually missed a key project deadline recently. Now I... I have to get my coworkers to double-check my reports, or just take over parts of them completely. I used to finish them on my own, but... I just can't right now. And outside of work, I've mostly stopped seeing people. I don't really do any of the routines that used to keep me steady, either. I just... haven't been doing much of anything.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight lately—like eating much less or much more than usual?
No, I don't think so. Um... I haven't really noticed any difference. I guess I'm eating about the same.
Have you had any thoughts about death or dying, or have you wished you were dead, or thought about harming yourself?

I don't know... I guess... sometimes. Like when I'm driving to work. I just... I catch myself thinking that maybe it would be easier if I just didn't get there. Just didn't arrive anywhere at all. Sometimes... sometimes the thought of just steering off the road pops into my head. It scares me when it happens. I end up gripping the steering wheel really tight, and... I usually have to pull over for a minute.
Have you noticed that your movements or speech have slowed down, or that you feel restless or agitated lately?

Um... I guess things are slower. People at work... they've been finishing my sentences in meetings. It just... it takes me a while to get the words out. And... walking from my desk to the test chamber... it feels really heavy. Like I'm moving through thick syrup, or something. I don't know.
Have you completely lost interest or pleasure in absolutely everything—like activities, work, hobbies, or even things you used to really enjoy?

Um... yeah, I guess so. I don't really do much anymore. My 3D printer for miniatures... it's just been sitting there with the same half-finished figure on it for months. I haven't touched it. And... things I used to do, like yoga or walking in the woods... they just feel like chores now. Like another task I have to get through, instead of something I actually want to do. So... yeah, I guess I don't really enjoy anything right now.
